name: BRAND TEXT
description: "We are a 100% Canadian Owned and Operated business operating out of Calgary, Alberta Canada.  We are an established business, having been in business for many years and we are a Direct Factory Wholesale and Retail distributor of High Quality Health Products and Luxury Bathroom products. As such we are able to provide a superior product for a much lower cost.  We Deal directly with our factories overseas to bring high quality, modern and elegant bathroom products that people desire for there homes. We also have the parts and expertise to provide expert after service to all of our clients. We are concerned not just with providing a product but the knowledge to enjoy it for many years.  We strive to build our business one customer at a time by providing excellent service that people can depend on. We also believe in upholding our business to high business standards and as such we are proud to be an Accredited Member of the Better Business Bureau of Southern Alberta."
